name: oracle
description: A sentinel for the Oracle council: senses forks in the road, nudges once, shows the council's paths above the prompt, and takes one-tap answers to the Oracle's question (/next a-d, /next answer).

cadence.title: Cadence
cadence.description: forks: nudge only at a fork in the road (a finished piece, a new direction, a stall, a decision, a long drift). every: nudge after every turn. ask: never nudge, only /next convene.

fastModel.title: Sensing model
fastModel.description: Model alias or id that decides whether a turn is a fork.
